description: Sovereign A&R, talent architecture, stewardship subscriptions, project commissions, and advisory engagements at Wild Lake Studio.

about.name: Wild Lake Studio

hasPart.name: Areas of practice.
hasPart.text: We scout talent and work with artists directly, or partner with record labels, galleries, and booking agencies. In either case, the artist enters the engagement willingly, on their own initiative or through a representative. Every engagement begins with an agreed scope and an upfront monthly Stewardship Subscription or fixed project fee. 01.0 // We develop raw material across mediums through focused critique, creative direction, and critical writing. The artist retains ownership and shapes how the work reaches others. 01.1 // We build the creator behind the work. Working across mediums, we help artists strip away external friction and sustain a long-term practice. Explore artist wellbeing. 01.2 // Traditional A&R reshapes the creator. We work with raw material in any form and at any stage, helping artists shape the work on their own terms. 01.3 // Audience development is asset building. We construct the physical, spatial, and digital channels for complex work. 02.0 // A controlled demolition of unsustainable habits and brittle systems, followed by a rebuild with the artist. Focused interventions create the conditions for an independent practice. 02.1 // We audit the structural alignment between how a creator lives and what they build. We restructure physical capacity and operational boundaries. 02.2 // Sustained operational support to manage the existential load of the artist over a ten-year horizon. 02.3 // Establishing internal clarity, sovereign boundaries, and focus mechanics under high-stakes execution.

hasPart.name: Retainer terms.
hasPart.text: Focused intervention. Space to execute. The monthly Stewardship Subscription keeps studio capacity available between interventions. We come close to observe and edit, then step away while the artist executes on their own timeline. Wild-Lake takes no percentage of artist earnings or ownership of their intellectual property. The client retains ownership of their work. The Studio retains its proprietary frameworks and licenses delivered framework materials for the client’s practice. Public-facing writing transfers to the client upon final settlement. The client triggers an intervention when it is needed. We agree response times, reserved capacity, and the scope of each intervention in advance. Periods of absence are part of the engagement, giving the artist room to work independently. Their consent and creative control remain explicit throughout. The subscription is paid monthly in advance for reserved availability across the agreed cadence. Project commissions carry a fixed fee.
